rules.guidance: Unsubscribe from manual subscriptions (takeUntil/async pipe/DestroyRef) — leaked subscriptions cause memory leaks and duplicate work.
Prefer `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` for components with immutable inputs; avoid heavy work in templates/getters re-run each CD cycle.
Don't touch the DOM directly (`document`, `nativeElement`); use Renderer2/bindings so it stays SSR-safe and testable.
`bypassSecurityTrust*` on untrusted content is an XSS sink; sanitize instead.
Keep complex logic/function calls out of templates (they run every change-detection); precompute in the component.
Use typed reactive forms and avoid `any` in form models.
Provide services at the right scope (`providedIn`); avoid re-providing a singleton service per component unintentionally.
